opening.argument: The footage presents a tour of BitClub's Iceland data center: a speaker describes inviting about 200 friends to visit, a participant connects network membership with mining Bitcoin, and another identifies mining equipment and explains how the technology has changed. Machines are also shown on screen. The title promotes earning Bitcoin, and a speaker calls a machine one that “prints money” in Bitcoin. Those are promotional claims, but the available content shows no concrete request for payment, private data, a wallet transfer, or another consequential viewer action. It supports a promotional mining-network tour, not an established deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: We invited about 200 of our friends to fly on out and come check out our data centers.
I am fortunate enough to be part of the BitClub network, which means I mine Bitcoin.
So this is an ant miner, this is the S5. When we started it was the S3s, the S5s, to the S7s, to the S9s. So this tech keeps getting faster and the chips smaller.
